title: Netherlands: Dutch Budget Crisis Lays Bare the Tension Between Defence Ambitions and… · 16 Sep
keywords: Netherlands, Dutch budget, welfare cuts, defence spending, inflation, purchasing power, coalition politics, Eurostat, European Union, fiscal policy, NATO, social security
notes: The Netherlands has entered a period of acute political turbulence as its coalition government attempts to reconcile a major push in defence spending with the financial pressures facing ordinary households. After facing sharp resistance from trade unions and opposition parties, the cabinet retreated from its harshest planned welfare cuts, adding roughly 1.5 billion euros to protect purchasing power. The episode has exposed deep fault lines within the governing coalition and rekindled a broader European debate about who bears the cost of rearmament.
